headword: {人間失格|にんげんしっかく}
gloss: No Longer Human (Dazai Osamu); unfit to be human

definitions.explanation: The last completed novel of Dazai Osamu, published in 1948, the year of his death: the notebooks of a man who feels unable to live among other people. One of the best-selling novels in Japan.

definitions.gloss: a failure as a human being; unfit to be a person
definitions.explanation: As an ordinary phrase, "disqualified as a human being": a harsh judgment of someone, or a half-joking judgment of oneself.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
- Published in 1948, the year ⟦{太宰治|だざいおさむ}→太宰治：31012_dazaiosamu⟧ took his own life; the first line of its first notebook, 「⟦{恥|はじ}→恥：12636_haji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{生涯|しょうがい}→生涯：03229_shougai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}って→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦{来|き}ました→来る：00254_kuru⟧」 ("Mine has been a life of much shame"), is widely known
- Constantly reprinted, and adapted for film and manga

USAGE:
- As an ordinary phrase (sense 2) it is strong when said of someone else; people often say it of themselves half-jokingly after a lazy or careless day

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{失格|しっかく}→失格：12195_shikkaku⟧: disqualification; being unfit
